gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Distinctive is the first word that comes to mind for Baumans, with its wide-open crescent c and strokes that never change thickness. And M PLUS Code Latin follows in friendly sans, bent like neon tubing and just as steady.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Smooth, wiry, a little bold: Baumans looks drawn with one continuous bit of wire, every stroke the same. M PLUS Rounded 1c gives it a gentle plain sans partner.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mandali: Baumans has no calligraphic swelling anywhere in its outlines. Mandali takes over in sans, with a generous entry into the e that keeps a long page of text moving easily.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-manjari: Manjari is the quiet one here, with an unvarying line. Its curves end in wide, unclosed terminals, so paragraphs of plain sans text glide past while Baumans handles the headline.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-meera-inimai: Meera Inimai has open-ended curves with room to breathe and a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line. Baumans adds the commanding crescent-wrench c up top, and Meera Inimai settles below as friendly sans-serif text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-metrophobic: Metrophobic reads smooth and modern, with nothing snagging the eye on a bend. Under Baumans, with its constant pen width, a long passage of sans text would glide along without a hitch.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mina: Stitched-thread simplicity, then a swagger. Baumans leads with its wrench-like c, and Mina follows in sans with generously unclosed curves on each small round letter.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mingzat: Mingzat reads curvy and unclamped, loose in the best way for a sans. But Baumans keeps its texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner, so the two feel playfully strict next to each other.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-molengo: Molengo brings wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, a quiet sans-serif habit. And Baumans, drawn like a neon tube, makes the strongest contrast: a display heading above a body that just gets on with it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-momo-trust-sans: Baumans opens with a crescent-wrench c and a stroke that never thins out. Momo Trust Sans, a plain sans with wide unclosed mouths, reads smoothly beneath it.
